اختلجوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَجُوا (iḵtalajū) /ix.ta.la.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلِجُوا (iḵtalijū) /ix.ta.li.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
